Swap-and-fix or used-set backtracking. O(n!).

For permutations basic I will build permutations by fixing one position at a time.

```python
def permute(nums):
    out = []
    used = [False] * len(nums)
    def rec(cur):
        if len(cur) == len(nums):
            out.append(cur[:]); return
        for i in range(len(nums)):
            if not used[i]:
                used[i] = True
                cur.append(nums[i])
                rec(cur)
                cur.pop()
                used[i] = False
    rec([])
    return out
```
